loginSubtitle: Restricted to the platform team, with Google only.
loginUnavailableDetail: Check your connection, turn off content blockers and try again.
errorGeneric: Could not sign in. Try again in a moment.
errorInvalidGoogleToken: We could not confirm your Google account. Try signing in again.
errorPlatformOnly: This account has no access to the admin.
errorPlatformDisabled: The admin is not available on this installation.
errorProviderDisabled: Google sign-in is unavailable right now.
errorTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
deniedDetail: This session does not belong to the platform system company. Sign out and enter with the right account.
disabledDetail: This installation has no platform admin.
accountsSoon: The list of accounts and subscriptions comes next.
auditSubtitle: The most recent admin events, newest first.
auditLoadError: Could not load the audit trail.
auditEmptyDescription: Sign-ins and data openings show up here.
linksSubtitle: What each link offers, how many accounts used it and when it ends.
linksEmptyDescription: Create the first link to invite accounts with a trial or a discount.
revokeDescription: The link stops accepting new uses. Whoever already used it keeps the offer.
formDescription: Choose the trial, the discount by cycle, the limit and the validity.
formLabelHint: Only the team sees this name.
formTrialHintNone: The account starts on Free and the discount applies from the first charge.
formTrialHintCard: The account saves the card and the first charge happens when the trial ends.
formTrialHintNoCard: The account uses Premium with no card and goes back to Free if it does not subscribe. It needs a usage limit and a validity of up to 90 days.
formMaxUsesHint: Leave empty for no limit. Required with no card.
formExpiresHintNoCard: Required with no card, up to 90 days from today.
formExpiresHint: Leave empty for a link that does not expire.
formRulesHint: The first rule that covers the cycle wins. Cycle 1 is the first charge; trial days do not count. Up to 20 rules, from 1% to 90%.
formMaxUsesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
formMaxUsesRequired: No card requires a usage limit.
formExpiryPast: The validity cannot be before today.
formExpiryTooFar: With no card, the validity is up to 90 days.
formCycleRangeInvalid: The last cycle cannot be lower than the first.
errorOffer_trial_days_without_trial: With no trial there are no trial days.
errorOffer_rule_out_of_range: A discount rule is out of bounds: 1% to 90%, cycles from 1.
errorOffer_expires_in_the_past: The validity cannot be before today.
errorOffer_no_card_requires_max_uses: No card requires a usage limit.
errorOffer_no_card_expiry_too_far: With no card, the validity is up to 90 days.
errorOffer_generic: The offer does not meet the rules of the platform.
errorActionGeneric: Could not finish. Try again in a moment.
